title: Your follow-up messages, for review
intro: These are the texts, emails and letters your PPC and mailer leads get over 12 months, word for word. Mark each one **Looks good**, or click **Change it** and type the wording you'd like. Words in amber are details we still need from you. Your answers save as you go, and nothing is sent until you approve.
footer: Prepared for MKM Luxury · November 2026 · You can come back to this page any time; your answers are saved.

msgs.subject: Who we are (and who we're not)

MKM Luxury is a real estate company that buys high-end homes and refurbishes them for the next family. Our offer is based on what your home is worth, so you get a fair price for the home you have today.

msgs.subject: 5 mistakes sellers make with high-end homes
msgs.text:
Hi [First name],

Selling a high-end home is different. Here are five mistakes we see most often:

1. Pricing off the wrong sales. A few big sales nearby can make a home look worth more, or less, than it is.
2. Spending on the wrong updates. Sellers often pay for projects buyers won't pay them back for.
3. Months of showings. Every weekend becomes cleaning, leaving and waiting for feedback.
4. Waiting for perfect timing. Holding out for the right season can cost more than it earns.
5. The wrong buyer. A buyer whose financing falls through sends you back to square one.

Selling to MKM avoids all five: we price your home as it is, you make no repairs, there are no showings, and you choose when to close.

Want to talk it through? Reply here or call me at [Ann's phone].

Ann

msgs.subject: Does timing really change the price?
msgs.text:
Hi [First name],

A question I hear a lot: "Should I wait for a better time to sell?"

Timing matters less than most people think. Market shifts move prices a little; condition, location and how the home is sold move them a lot more.

If you're weighing when to sell, I'm happy to look at your timeline with you. No pressure either way.

Ann

Anything else on your mind? Just reply. I read every email myself.

msgs.text:
